item.title: Under-Sink Organization Ideas: A Simple System That Stays Tidy
item.description: A cabinet under the sink is one of the easiest places for clutter to hide. Pipes divide the available space, bottles get pushed to the back, and a small leak can turn a neat cabinet into a damaged mess. The solution is not to buy more containers first. A better system starts with measurements, clear zones, and storage that works around the plumbing. These under-sink organization ideas are designed for ordinary kitchens and bathrooms, including small cabinets where every inch matters.
